BluePearl Pet Hospital – Serving Ann Arbor and western suburbs of Detroit.
We are located in Ann Arbor, also serving the communities of Westland, Plymouth, Canton, Whitmore Lake, Saline, Willis, Belleville, Dexter and Ypsilanti.
Our reviews.
Our Reviews
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, seconds count. If your pet requires a veterinary specialist, we are ready for that too. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
In an emergency, call ahead to your BluePearl vet and let us know you’re coming.
Learn more about your emergency visit.
Specialty care
Our veterinary specialists work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.
Learn more about veterinary specialists.
See Specialties and Services
Our
veterinarians.
Caring for your pets is our passion. Meet our team of veterinarians here to help you and your pet.
See Veterinarians
About BluePearl Pet Hospital Ann Arbor.
Our veterinarians and technicians work together as a skilled team, ready to perform emergency surgeries on-site. That may mean an emergency C-section or treatment of life-threatening gastric torsion. We treat wounds, vomiting and diarrhea. If your dog ate something bad, we know what to do. Our emergency vets in Ann Arbor also have access to the expertise of multiple veterinary specialties through the larger BluePearl animal hospital in Southfield.
We understand the financial pressures some face, and so we provide cost estimates up front. No one can put a price on your love for your pet, but we can show you a range of options.
Pet owners
At BluePearl Pet Hospitals, providing our customers with remarkable service is a top priority. We’re committed to making your veterinary visit as smooth as possible.
Have questions prior to your visit? We’re happy to help. Contact our hospital team at

Testimonials.
“Thank you so much for the love and care for my Baby girl Roxxy. A special thanks to Erin who was so kind during our visit and thank you to Christina for the thoughtful phone call the next day after Roxxy’s procedure. It said a lot of how much you care for your patients.
Thank you also to the doctor that did my baby’s procedure and explaining everything thing. I also appreciate talking to Mizera to know what kind of activities my girl cannot do. God bless you all for caring.”
–Dina K.
“I want to thank everyone at BluePearl Pet Hospital Ann Arbor (Chloe, Ashli, Nicole, Brooke, Chelsea, Kacey and Dr. Close) for their love, care, and professionalism. They made a difference in so many ways and I will be forever indebted.”
–Rico and Rex
